title: Python Fundamentals for Data Science
overview: This module contains 16 lessons from the PDF curriculum, retaining the original order and subtopics. Work through concepts, inspect examples, and document the evidence and limitations.
learning_outcomes: Explain the main concepts in Python Fundamentals for Data Science.
Apply a relevant technique to a small synthetic example and interpret the output.
Evaluate assumptions, edge cases, and limitations before communicating a conclusion.
